ex.en: Press this button to eject the disc from the player.
ex.zh: 按下這個按鈕就能把光碟從播放機彈出來。

ex.en: The security guard ejected the noisy man from the theater.
ex.zh: 保全把吵鬧的男子請出了戲院。

ex.en: The ejection of the noisy fans surprised no one.
ex.zh: 吵鬧的球迷被趕出場，沒有人感到意外。

ex.en: The pilot's ejection from the plane saved his life.
ex.zh: 飛行員彈射離機救了他一命。
